$comment: pulley/registry/blocks/org/manifest.json — created 2026-08-12 (T-11), updated 2026-08-13 (T-10b: the nav entry carries its own href, so the routes below are ordered for reading rather than to steer the nav link). The org core block — organizations, membership, invitations, and org switching. DEPENDS ON auth: it references auth_user by id and never re-declares a person. This dep is what makes the block pair exercise the resolver for real — auth must install first and its migrations must run first, or the org_member foreign key has nothing to point at. DATABASE_URL is declared here with flags identical to auth's, which the resolver treats as a shared variable (a warning) rather than a conflict. `packages`/`devPackages` follow the T-11 contract; shared ranges are byte-identical to auth's because the installer refuses incompatible 0.x caret keys. Updated 2026-08-17 (G7): `hooks.init` points at server/eventsInit.ts, which puts this block's emitted events on the app's event bus at startup — that is how another block reacts to org.member.joined without importing org. The kit floor comes with it: the server `init` hook landed in @sveltejs/kit 2.10, and an older app would drop the wiring silently.
name: org
description: Organizations, membership roles, single-use invitations, and server-checked org switching.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Postgres connection string the org tables live in. Same database as the auth block — org_member holds a foreign key into auth_user.

env.name: ORG_INVITE_TTL_HOURS
env.description: How many hours an invitation stays valid. Defaults to 72. Must be a positive integer.
